REACHED THE GOAL.

What I did: I typed 'Buy milk' into the box and pressed Enter, and it went straight onto the list with the count changing to '1 left'. I added a long task about calling the landlord, and it wrapped over four lines inside its row without being cut off. I typed 'Return library books' and used the Add button instead of Enter, and that worked the same way. I ticked the box next to 'Buy milk', clicked Active, and only the two unfinished tasks showed. Clicking Completed showed only 'Buy milk', ticked and struck through. Back on All, I clicked Edit on 'Return library books', which turned the row into a text box with a Save button. I changed the text to 'Return library books before Saturday' and clicked Save, and the new name stuck. To tidy up I clicked Clear completed, which removed 'Buy milk', then clicked Delete on the other two. The list ended up empty with '0 left' and the 'Nothing here yet' message.

What confused me: while renaming, I pressed Enter expecting it to save, since Enter adds a task in the box at the top. Nothing happened and the text box stayed open, so I had to click Save. That inconsistency was the one thing that tripped me up.

Where I hesitated: Clear completed and Delete both act immediately with no confirmation and no undo. That was fine here, but I paused before clicking Delete because I was not sure whether it would ask first. Everything else was clear and the screen text was easy to read throughout.
